problem.title: Find one task log - build

inputs.environment: Existing authorized Airflow 3 training instance and isolated DAG folder. If access or supported version is unavailable, report environment_blocked; a pasted DAG is not execution evidence.

expected_output.run_id: actual triggered run ID, supplied by observed Airflow output

constraints: Trigger only in the isolated training instance; no external notification or production run.
Use the supplied source; the task is locating its actual run and log, not inventing a new DAG.
